import hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,os
assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,11,15)
assert os.getuid()==1007 and os.getgid()==1007
versions={}
for name,expected in [('node','v24.20.0'),('npm','11.19.0'),('codex','codex-cli 0.153.4')]:
 value=subprocess.check_output([name,'--version'],text=True).strip()
 assert value==expected,(name,value)
 versions[name]=value
value=subprocess.check_output(['uv','--version'],text=True).strip()
assert value.split()[:2]==['uv','0.12.10'];versions['uv']=value
raw=subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,'-m','pip','freeze','--all'])
entries=sorted(raw.splitlines());digest=hashlib.sha256(b'\n'.join(entries)+b'\n').hexdigest()
assert len(entries)==69 and digest=='570e1651694fe0e30bbd07a231c2f70cccf09cd18503b8ead34fdfd50f5f3abd'
check=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','check'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
for name in ('openspec','specify','cc-sdd'):assert shutil.which(name) is None
for name in ('auth.json','config.toml'):assert not (pathlib.Path('/home/bench/.codex')/name).exists()
with open('/opt/agent/bin/codex','rb') as stream:binary_sha=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version.split()[0],'versions':versions,'dependency_count':len(entries),'dependency_sha256':digest,'pip_check':check.stdout.strip(),'sdd_commands_absent':True,'codex_binary_sha256':binary_sha,'uid':os.getuid(),'gid':os.getgid()},indent=2))
